o.text: From Proto-Turkic *kaŕgan- (“to earn”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰴𐰕𐰍𐰣 (qazɣan-, “to conquer, gain, win”), Turkish kazanmak, Chuvash хӑрхӑн (hărh̬ăn, “miser”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یاشل (yaşıl), from Proto-Turkic *yāĺïl (“green”). Cognates include Turkish yeşil, Turkmen ýaşyl, Gagauz eşil.
A derivation from Proto-Turkic *köt + -ik. Cognate with Chuvash кут (kut, “stump; buttocks”).
Borrowed from Russian штрих (štrix), from German Strich.
